name: C12 Quantum Electronics
description: C12 Quantum Electronics builds quantum processors using carbon nanotube-based spin qubits. Their technology combines the coherence advantages of spin qubits with the unique electronic properties of ultra-pure carbon nanotubes to create scalable quantum computers.

products.name: Carbon Nanotube Quantum Processor
products.description: Quantum processor using ultra-pure carbon nanotube spin qubits for extended coherence times

highlights: Pioneered carbon nanotube-based spin qubits — a unique approach to quantum computing hardware
Raised EUR 18M including a EUR 10M seed round covered by TechCrunch
Founded by researchers from ENS Paris with deep materials science expertise
